description: Two patients share the same phone number and have similar names (Aarav vs Arjun Gupta) — caller does not specify the child's name.
turns: Mere bete ke liye Dr. Sethi ke saath appointment chahiye tha.

expected.notes: Sunita Gupta (pt_0008) is guardian of both Aarav (pt_0006) and Arjun (pt_0007) Gupta. The caller says 'mere bete' (my son) without specifying which child. Unlike cv_0008 where the child's first name 'Aarav' was given, here it is missing. A naive agent might pick the first child alphabetically. Correct behavior: escalate ambiguous_patient because it cannot determine which child to book for.
